heading: Vehicle wraps and protection from our Delta studio
paragraphs: AK Wraps & Customs is a vehicle customization and protection shop in Delta, BC, led by owner Akash. Our services include vinyl colour changes, clear and coloured paint protection film, window tint, ceramic coating, paint correction and custom finishing.

Start with your vehicle’s year, make and model, the finish you want and any existing paint damage or modifications. We discuss film choices, preparation and coverage before confirming the project scope and quote. Explore our photographed builds to see the types of work we undertake.

award.heading: Award-winning vehicle wrapping
award.text: AK Wraps & Customs received the 2026 Quality Business Award for Best Vehicle Wrapping in New Westminster, British Columbia. Quality Business Awards lists our shop with a quality score of 95% or higher. Our studio is located in Delta and welcomes drivers from across Greater Vancouver.
award.label: View our 2026 award listing

ownerRecognition.heading: Additional recognition
ownerRecognition.text: Owner Akash reports that Wrapshop Recognition ranked AK Wraps & Customs among the top three wrap shops in Greater Vancouver.
